title.narrative: Energy Transition Facility - Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO)

description.narrative: The purpose of this facility is to provide bilateral support to developing countries regarding their transition to a fully sustainable energy supply. In doing so, the facility contributes to combating climate change and promoting stability in the ring around Europe, particularly on its southern flank. The facility will give specific Dutch sustainable energy/energy efficiency solutions, policy insights and expertise a central place in energy cooperation with a limited number of countries (3 to 5) in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) (ring of instability around Europe) and possibly two countries in East Africa with which an energy relationship has already been established (Tanzania and Mozambique). The facility will give priority to those countries that ask the Netherlands for support in their energy transition and where energy cooperation is part of a broader bilateral relationship. It concerns a contract for EUR 1 million per year through the framework agreement with International Enterprise Agenday (RVO) with a duration of 4 years (2017-2021)
